import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for price vs. megapixels, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', markers={0: 'o', 1: 'X'}, palette='deep', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Title and labels
plt.title('Price vs. Megapixels of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type and Video Capability', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Customize legend
handles, labels = scatter.get_legend_handles_labels()
plt.legend(handles=handles, labels=labels, title='Sensor Type and Video Capability', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
